exposure: Standardized patient counseling incorporating a validated vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success likelihood calculator
predicted likelihood of successful trial of labor after cesarean
Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Vaginal Birth After Cesarean calculator
cohort: Term singleton pregnancies with a history of one to two cesarean deliveries at a single tertiary-care academic medical center
finding: Incorporating a VBAC success likelihood calculator into patient counseling was associated with a decreased risk of failed trial of labor after cesarean without affecting the overall VBAC rate.
mod_finding: Formal incorporation of a vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) likelihood calculator into patient counseling was associated with a decreased risk of failed trial of labor after cesarean, without affecting the overall VBAC rate.
